title: RatingsBatch
description: Request body for POST /api/ratings — bulk variant of the single-rating PUT. The game server batches stale ratings here so a periodic flush doesn't require one HTTP call per (player, gameType). Each entry is independently upserted against the consumer's playerRatings store using the same updatedAt guard as the single-rating endpoint: per-entry, an older push is silently skipped without failing the whole batch.

ratings.description: Up to 500 (player, gameType) rating snapshots in one POST. Order within the array is not significant.

playerName.description: Player name. Case-insensitive identity — the consumer lowercases this to match its playerKey. Display casing tracked separately via match envelopes.

gameType.description: Registry name of the GameType. Must exist in the consumer's catalog or the entry is rejected.

updatedAt.description: Game-server-local timestamp. Same semantics as the single-rating push: an older value is skipped, not an error.
